correctness.rationale: Every private leaf forces either itself or its support into a dominating set, so each support is internally dominated even after adding bridge edges; all other vertices have only internal neighbors. Restricting to blocks and taking unions are inverse size-preserving maps. The joining tree on connected blocks makes a connected simple graph. Independently partitioning dominating sets of the 36-edge seed by the subset of its 17 nonleaf vertices reproduced all 23 nonzero coefficients, D(-4)=0 and D'(-4)=1100417597440000. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent-checks/check_domination.py with the frozen package directory as input. The K2 and P3 factors evaluate to 8 and -20, so multiplicities add to exactly k. Every integer at least 2 is a sum of 2s and 3s; the proof does not cover order 33k+1 or claim optimality of the minimum order.

evidence: A private leaf w at support u has N[w] contained in N[u], even after deleting any added interblock edge. Both endpoints are therefore domination-covered in the edge-deleted graph.
Delete all joining edges one at a time to recover the product of k known seed factors and the K2 and P3 factors. Their orders contribute 33k+2a+3b and the latter factors do not vanish at -4.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The established theorem delivers exactly the claimed product for all parameters. Nonvanishing of two elementary factors and parity give exact multiplicity and the full order range immediately, so lack of identical wording is immaterial.

evidence: Alikhani–Griswold ask for infinitely many graphs with D(G,-4)=0 without a connectivity qualifier.
Joining the existing seed blocks at leaf supports is the attachment of irrelevant edges in the sense of Kotek et al., Definition 3.8.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Disjoint unions already answer the literal infinite-family question. Requiring connectivity is stronger, but the published irrelevance criterion lets one add the necessary edges without changing the disjoint-union polynomial. value.rationale: The connectivity and multiplicity questions are motivated, but this particular family follows by unconditional application of the known irrelevant-edge criterion to the already published seed, with K2/P3 padding and elementary parity. There is no new obstruction, seed or threshold result; for example the skipped order 33k+1 is not shown impossible. The correct immediate corollary is useful exposition but does not add a distinct scientific result at the stated standard.
